categoryText.implantology: From a single missing tooth to a full arch: implants that look, feel and work like natural teeth.
categoryText.digital-implant: 3D scans, digital impressions and computer-guided surgery for precise, more comfortable treatment.
categoryText.aesthetic: Zirconia, veneers and whitening designed in our own lab for a natural, luminous smile.
categoryText.general: Endodontics, oral surgery, hygiene and gentle care for the youngest patients.

desc.single-implant: A titanium implant replaces the missing root and a crown made in our lab completes the tooth — without touching the neighbouring teeth.
desc.multiple-implants: Several missing teeth are restored on a small number of implants with fixed crowns or a bridge, planned in 3D.
desc.all-on-4: A complete fixed arch supported by four implants. In suitable cases the fixed provisional teeth are placed on the same day.
desc.all-on-6: A full fixed arch on six implants for extra support and stability, ideal when bone volume allows it.
desc.replacing-old-bridges: Failing or unaesthetic old bridges are removed and replaced with implant-supported restorations that last.
desc.bone-grafting-sinus-lift: When bone is insufficient, regenerative techniques rebuild the volume needed to place implants safely.
desc.3d-ct-scan: A three-dimensional CBCT scan shows bone, nerves and sinuses in detail — the foundation of every implant plan.
desc.digital-impressions: An intraoral scanner replaces traditional impression paste: fast, precise and comfortable.
desc.guided-surgery: Implants are planned on the computer and placed through a surgical guide for precision and faster healing.
desc.digital-smile-design: Your new smile is designed digitally in harmony with your face, so you can see the result before treatment.
desc.zirconia-crowns: Strong, metal-free zirconia crowns designed and milled in our own laboratory for a natural look.
desc.veneers: Thin ceramic shells that correct shape, colour and small gaps with minimal preparation.
desc.bridges: Fixed bridges that replace one or more teeth, made with precision in our digital lab.
desc.teeth-whitening: Professional whitening that brightens your smile safely under clinical supervision.
desc.endodontics: Root canal treatment that saves the natural tooth and removes pain and infection.
desc.oral-surgery: Extractions, wisdom teeth and minor oral surgery performed with care and precision.
desc.hygiene: Professional cleaning and prevention to keep gums and implants healthy for the long term.
desc.children: Gentle, patient care that helps children feel safe at the dentist from their very first visit.

sameDay.intro: If you have lost many or all of your teeth, or your teeth can no longer be saved, you may be able to receive a complete fixed arch of teeth on implants — in a single day.

what.title: What are same-day teeth?
what.text: A full arch of fixed teeth is attached to a small number of implants (usually four or six, as in All-on-4 and All-on-6) immediately after surgery. You do not spend months with a removable denture: you go home with fixed provisional teeth, and after healing they are replaced by the final bridge made in our laboratory.

benefits.title: Fixed, not removable
benefits.text: Teeth stay in place: no adhesives, no movement when you speak or smile.

benefits.title: One day of surgery
benefits.text: Extractions, implants and fixed provisional teeth in the same session.

benefits.title: Fewer trips
benefits.text: Ideal for patients travelling from abroad thanks to the in-house lab.

benefits.title: Confidence back
benefits.text: Eat, speak and smile again with natural-looking teeth.

whyHere.title: Why it is possible here
whyHere.text: Same-day teeth need 3D diagnosis, precise surgery and a laboratory working side by side, on the same day. Albania Dental Clinic has all three under one roof — and is one of the few clinics in Albania able to offer the complete treatment.

sameDay.ctaHow: See the day step by step

sameDayHow.intro: A typical same-day treatment, from the first contact to your new smile. Your own plan is confirmed after the 3D scan and the consultation.

steps.title: First contact
steps.text: Send us a recent panoramic X-ray or CT through the form or WhatsApp. We give you a first opinion and plan the visit.

steps.title: Consultation & 3D CBCT
steps.text: At the clinic we examine you and take a 3D scan to measure bone volume and plan implant positions.

steps.title: Digital planning
steps.text: The surgery and your new teeth are designed together on the computer. You see and approve the plan.

steps.title: Surgery
steps.text: Under local anaesthesia, failing teeth are removed and the implants are placed following the plan.

steps.title: Teeth from our lab
steps.text: While you rest, our technicians prepare your fixed provisional teeth in the laboratory next door.

steps.title: You leave with fixed teeth
steps.text: The same day the teeth are fixed on the implants. After healing, they are replaced by the final bridge.

sameDayHow.note: Same-day loading is possible only when bone quality and general health allow it. If not, we will explain the best alternative clearly.

sameDayCandidates.intro: Most adults who have lost many teeth, or whose teeth can no longer be saved, can be treated with fixed teeth on implants. The final answer always comes from the 3D scan and the clinical exam.

good.title: You may be a good candidate if
items: You wear a removable denture and want fixed teeth
Many of your teeth are loose, broken or painful
An old bridge or implant work is failing
You have been told you have too little bone (bone grafting may help)
You want to reduce the number of trips for treatment

evaluate.title: We evaluate carefully if
items: You have uncontrolled diabetes or other serious general conditions
You take medication that affects bone (for example some osteoporosis drugs)
You are undergoing or have recently undergone radiotherapy of the head and neck

check.title: Quick self-check
check.intro: Four questions, one minute. This is not a diagnosis — it only helps us prepare your consultation.

questions.q: How many of your own teeth are you missing?

check.resultText: Based on your answers, a free consultation is the right next step. Send us your X-ray if you have one and we will prepare a personal plan.
check.resultNoXray: No X-ray yet? No problem — we take a 3D scan at the clinic.

privacy.title: Who we are
privacy.text: Albania Dental Clinic, led by Dr. Donela Dede, is responsible for the personal data collected through this website.

privacy.title: What data we collect
privacy.text: When you send a request we collect your name, contact details, your message and, if you choose to attach them, X-rays or other medical images.

privacy.title: Why we use it
privacy.text: Only to answer your request, prepare a treatment plan and organise your visit. We do not sell your data and do not use it for unrelated marketing.

privacy.title: Health data
privacy.text: X-rays and clinical information are health data. They are processed with your explicit consent, accessed only by clinical staff and protected with appropriate security measures.

privacy.title: How long we keep it
privacy.text: Requests that do not lead to treatment are deleted after a reasonable period. Clinical records are kept for the period required by law.

privacy.title: Your rights
privacy.text: You can ask to access, correct or delete your data, or withdraw your consent at any time, by writing to the clinic.

cookies.title: What cookies are
cookies.text: Cookies are small files saved by your browser that help a website work and remember your choices.

cookies.title: Necessary
cookies.text: Always active: a cookie that remembers your language, and your cookie choice (stored in your browser). They contain no personal data and are not used for advertising.

cookies.title: Advertising (Google Ads)
cookies.text: Only if you click “Accept”: Google Ads cookies measure whether a visit from one of our ads leads to a consultation request or a WhatsApp message. Google Ads is not loaded at all until you accept. Provider: Google Ireland Ltd.

cookies.title: Google Maps
cookies.text: The map on the contact page is provided by Google and may set its own cookies. It loads only if you accepted cookies or click “Show map”.

cookies.title: Changing your choice
cookies.text: You can change or withdraw your choice at any time via “Cookie settings” at the bottom of every page, or by deleting cookies in your browser.
